Measures adopted for family planning
*281. SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the various family planning measures
adopted by the third world and other
developing countries in the world to
control the population explosion;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have been
planning to adopt a China like policy to
control population in the country in near
future; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Permission for clinical trials
*282. SHRI KHAN GHUFRAN
ZAHIDI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Drug
Controller General of India (DCGI) is using
discretion in granting permissions for clinical
trails, bio-equivalences and marketing
permissions;
(b) whether it is also a fact that often
there are variations in the decisions from
company to company; and
(c) if so, the guidelines and specific
directions from his Ministry to DCGI in
this regard?
Reconstitution of NCM
*283. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have been
approached to reconstitute the National
Commission for Minorities (NCM);
(b) if so, the details of the demands; and
(c) Government’s reaction thereto?
ST status to Pahari-Pathari
Community of Kashmir
*284. MIRZA ABDUL RASHID: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to refer to reply to Unstarred
Question 2399 given in the Rajya Sabha on
13th August, 2001, and state:

86
WIN2\SESSION\3905RS 86
(a) whether it is a fact that the proposal of
conferment of ST status to Pahari-Pathari
speaking people of J and K is fully processed
and complete in all respect; and
(b) if so, by when Government will confer
ST status to this Community?
Kandla Port Trust
*285. SHRI BRAHMAKUMAR
BHATT:
SHRI ANANTRAY DEV-
SHANKER DAVE:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government of Gujarat has
requested the Government to revert part of
the Kandla Port limit which was earlier part
of Salaya minor port for the development of
an oil terminal for Essar Refinery and other
private sector refineries that may come up in
future;
(b) if so, whether Government are
considering to accept the request; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Stiff competition for MUL
*286. DR. Y. LAKSHMI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Maruti Udyog Ltd. is facing
stiff competition from private sector new
models introduced in the market;
(b) the comparative sale figures of the
Maruti Models vis-a-vis other reputed models;
and
(c) the steps taken to popularise Maruti
Models?
Subtherapeutic drug formulations
*287. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
many substandard subtherapeutic drug
formulations are available in the market
and vast rural market is flooded with this;
(b) if so, whether some effective
measures are being planned to prevent
marketing of such drug formulations; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Disposal of pending cases
*288. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of LAW, JUSTICE
AND COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to the news-item captioned,
’’20 Lakh Mukadme 2005 Tak Niptane Ki
Yojana’’, which appeared in the Rashtriya
Sahara, dated 31st May, 2001;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
Government’s reaction thereto; and
(c) the details of the steps taken by
Government for quick disposal of the
cases pending in different courts in the
country?
World Bank suggestion on tobacco
*289. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the World Bank
Economists have suggested that money
saved on tobacco by banning its use
altogether, if utilised on other goods, will
create more jobs than those displaced;

to make the tobacco ban more effective?

Agenda for development of North
Eastern Region
2120. SHRI INDRAMONI BORA:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH-EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the major agenda for Development
of North Eastern Region;
(b) the short-term and long-term
strategies;
(c) whether Government are aware that
funds allocated for specific projects in many
States of North Eastern Region are either
diverted or unutilised;
(d) if so, whether Government are
planning to tackle the situation; and
(e) whether Government have any
agency to monitor utilisation of fund
released for specific projects particularly
of the fund allocated from non-lapsable
pool?
Accruals and expenditure from
non-lapsable pool
2121. SHRI KHAGEN DAS: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH-
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of accruals and
expenditure from the non-lapsable pool
during the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the details of projects sanctioned
and funds released during the said period,
State-wise;
(c) whether the States encountered any
difficulties in getting funds for sanctioned
projects under non-lapsable pool during the
year 2000-2001; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to tackle the
situation?
Pendency of State projects
2122. SHRI KHAGEN DAS: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH-
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the corpus available during the year
2000-2001 under non-lapsable pool;
(b) the pendency position of the
projects submitted by various State
Governments, State-wise; and
(c) the steps being taken to expedite
sanction of the pending projects?
Disinvestment in blue-chip
undertakings
2123. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have prepared a three-year road map to

459
WIN2\SESSION\3907RS 459
carry out disinvestment in blue-chip
undertakings in telecom, power and oil
sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when action in this regard is likely
to be initiated?
Disinvestment of various
PSUs
2124. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have off-loaded their stake in various Public
Sector Undertakings (PSUs) during the last
one year;
(b) if so, the names of the PSUs
disinvested with the names of prospective
buyers with prices/stakes; and
(c) the names of other PSUs which are
likely to be disinvested during the next two
years?
Disinvestment of PSUs
2125.  SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVEST-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the Public Sector
Undertakings in which disinvestment had
been effected during the years 1998-1999,
1999-2000, 2000-2001 and 1st April to
October, 2001;
(b) the percentage of the equity which
has been disinvested in each PSU; and
(c) the total amount collected by
Government through disinvestment?
Disinvestment of  PSUs
2126. SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are divesting the  majority stake in certain
key PSUs including BHEL; and
(b) if so, the details of such PSUs
including the percentage of Government
equity to be diluted in these units and the
time table, if any, for the above process?
Disinvestment of certain PSUs in
Tamil Nadu
2127. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Central Sector PSUs
in Tamil Nadu that are in acute financial
crunch;
(b) whether any proposal has been sent
to Government for the disinvestment of
these PSUs in Tamil Nadu; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Disinvestment of major  oil
companies
2128. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that major oil
companies are being taken up for
privatisation/disinvestment;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when, it is likely to be imple-
mented; and
(d) the expected revenue inflow through
this process?

the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY

(a) the details of recognised private
hospitals attached to CGHS in different
parts of the country, hospital-wise;
(b) the details of procedure of treatment
